subject.title: Browserbase integration broken: static cdpUrl returns 404, needs session API

question: Should OpenClaw support Browserbase Sessions API lifecycle now as a first-party browser profile driver, route it through a generic browser-backend/plugin seam, or document Browserbase Sessions API workflows as unsupported for now?
rationale: The fix would define a commercial-service integration boundary and new credential/session lifecycle behavior, so automation cannot safely choose the product scope or security contract.

options.title: Revise First-Party Driver
options.body: Accept a Browserbase driver only after route coverage, credential/SecretRef policy, signed URL redaction, cleanup semantics, upgrade behavior, and live OpenClaw browser proof are resolved.

options.title: Design Generic Backend Seam
options.body: Keep Browserbase behind a broader browser backend/plugin API so service-specific drivers can live outside core once registration is available.

options.title: Document Unsupported For Now
options.body: Remove or revise the Browserbase static setup guidance until maintainers are ready to own Browserbase Sessions API lifecycle behavior.

recommendation.title: Revise First-Party Driver
recommendation.body: Accept a Browserbase driver only after route coverage, credential/SecretRef policy, signed URL redaction, cleanup semantics, upgrade behavior, and live OpenClaw browser proof are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history on browser plugin ownership and the core-versus-plugin boundary implicated by this decision.
